steps.text: Start Anubis and open the local address. Retrieve your private token from [[value:.anubis/identities.json]]. Paste it into [[field:Access token]] and click [[control:Open workspace]]. Never share the token.

Click [[control:New engagement]]. Set [[field:Customer workload name]] = [[value:Larch Media Archive manual playbook]]. Click [[control:Add Continuous processing]]. Click [[control:Add Document or search assistant]]. Click [[control:Continue]].
Set [[field:Factory users]] = [[value:One organisation]]. Set [[field:Do activities run at the same time?]] = [[value:Yes — overlapping demand]].
Set [[field:Component name 1]] = [[value:Video analysis]]. Set [[field:Compute location 1]] = [[value:In this factory]]. Set [[field:Reserve dedicated capacity 1]] [[state:unchecked]].

Set [[field:Component name 2]] = [[value:Archive search]]. Set [[field:Compute location 2]] = [[value:In this factory]]. Set [[field:Reserve dedicated capacity 2]] [[state:unchecked]]. Set [[field:Relationship 2]] = [[value:Independent]]. Set [[field:Search and indexing location 2]] = [[value:Existing service outside this AI Factory]].
Select [[control:Video analysis]]. Set [[field:Sizing method]] = [[value:Reference capacity for independent work]]. This uses complete independent GPU groups and the explicit scenario assumptions.
Set [[field:Work unit]] = [[value:frame]]. Set [[field:Peak work units per second]] = [[value:300]]. Set [[field:GPUs per reference group]] = [[value:8]].
Set [[field:Required GPU memory in GB]] = [[value:40]]. Set [[field:H200 work units per second per group]] = [[value:100]]. Set [[field:B200 work units per second per group]] = [[value:160]].

Set [[field:B300 work units per second per group]] = [[value:200]]. Set [[field:Reference source and conditions]] = [[value:Fictional consultant planning assumption for this demonstration, not measured benchmark evidence. 60 concurrent archived video streams sampled at 5 frames/s. Fixed 1080p analysis model, BF16, independent complete eight-GPU worker groups.]].

Check [[field:Independent reference groups can serve this demand]] and [[field:I accept this reference capacity and its scope]]. Leave [[field:Reference includes local search and indexing]] [[state:unchecked]] for this component. These example capacities are accepted planning assumptions, not measured benchmark results.
Set [[field:Model preset]] = [[value:dense8b]]. Set [[field:Describe demand using]] = [[value:Requests per minute]].
Set [[field:Peak requests per minute]] = [[value:40]]. Set [[field:Model calls per request or job]] = [[value:1]].
Set [[field:Input tokens per model call]] = [[value:2000]]. Set [[field:Output tokens per model call]] = [[value:500]].

Confirm [[control:GPU estimate inputs are ready]]. Retain the displayed B300 enterprise deployment profile and [[field:Sensitivity envelope]] = [[value:±30%]]. Check [[field:Use these planning assumptions]]. Click [[control:Calculate estimate]].

Read the GPU workload comparison. Expected B300 = [[value:24]], B200 = [[value:24]], H200 = [[value:32]] GPUs. These workload counts are separate from the [[value:256]] GPU factory deployment anchor. Click [[control:Export result]] to save the calculation.

Click [[control:Continue to Design handoff]], then [[control:Prepare projection]]. Read the executive summary and download the design intake and companion specification. Unresolved network and storage measurements remain explicit.

Click [[control:Explain this to me]]. Set [[field:Explanation connection]] = [[value:Deterministic explanation — no model]]. Click [[control:Generate explanation]]. The saved calculation cannot be changed by this action.

Read the explanation of the workload GPUs, deployment anchor, memory, storage and all network roles. Expand [[control:Source fields and assumptions]] to trace the explanation. Click [[control:Download explanation]], then [[control:Close]].

Scroll down within [[control:Explain this to me]] to read [[control:Factory networks]] and [[control:What to do next]]. Expand [[control:Source fields and assumptions]] if needed. Click [[control:Download explanation]] to save the text. Scroll to the top and click [[control:Close]] to continue.

Set [[field:Completion notes]] = [[value:Planning requirements and explanation delivered. Outstanding network and storage measurements remain in the companion specification.]]. Check [[field:I confirm that these selected requirements are delivered.]]. Click [[control:Complete engagement]].
The engagement is complete. Its exact calculation, handoff and explanation remain saved. Use [[control:Cases]] to reopen the engagement and [[control:Saved deliverables]] to retrieve its documents.
